Facilities for the Handicapped
Funding is proposed for continuation of the existing program of constructing curb ramps throughout the city.
Housing Service Center
Funding is proposed for continuation of the Housing Service Center project with an annual increase of 5%.
Redevelopment Program
Substantial funding is proposed for capital improvements in the San Antonio Redevelopment Project and $450,000 is included annually for Redevelopment Agency administration. The specific breakdown of projects proposed in the San Antonio Plaza Redevelopment Project is included in Table II.
Program Planning and Administration
This project provides for continuation of existing CDBG - funded staff in the Grant Coordination Office, Property and Code Enforcement - Housing Division, and Finance Department. A 5% annual increase is included.
